records.text: The Daily Mail headline alleged Owens was in crisis, with her family begging her to disappear and fearing she might be killed; it cited unnamed insiders’ whispers of a foreign reconnaissance mission and links to a secret military location. These are reported allegations, not established facts.
records.speaker: Daily Mail

appearances.snippet: It's getting so unhinged, but the Daily Mail runs this headline. Just, I don't even know. Somebody's gonna have to give me the SparkNotes on this. 'Candace Owens in crisis.' This is like the Michael Jackson thing where you pretend the person's just like radical. It's what they do to like Justin Bieber. He's like, you gotta, like, they're on drugs. 'Candace Owens in crisis as family begs her to disappear and pray she isn't killed.' In big print, 'Insiders reveal whispers of a foreign—' ... reconnaissance mission and her links to a secret military location.

conveyance.original_source: Daily Mail headline read by Owens at 38:00; article not read in full
